name: Prof. (Dr.) Sadananda Prusty
bio: Prof. Sadananda Prusty has over 25 years of rich experience in academic leadership, corporate training, and research in Management, Applied Economics, and Public Finance. He has published extensively in peer-reviewed journals and spearheads industrial collaborations for SMLS.

publications.title: Efficacy of Monetary Policy Transmission in Emerging Markets
Infrastructure Investment and Regional Development: A Case Study of Western India

achievements: Advisory Board Member, Rajasthan Economic Association

name: Dr. Amit Kumar Goel
bio: Dr. Amit Kumar Goel specializes in Soft Computing, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Big Data Warehouses. He drives the IBM Academic Initiative at SPSU to train students in Cloud Technologies and Modern Frameworks.

publications.title: A Hybrid Deep Learning Model for Climate Prediction in Arid Zones
publications.journal: IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics

publications.title: Distributed Ledger Architectures for Secure Healthcare Records Exchange

achievements: Senior Member, Computer Society of India

name: Dr. Naveen Kumar
bio: Dr. Naveen Kumar directs CAD/CAM labs and mechanical engineering research at SPSU. His work targets solid mechanics, vibration analysis, and modern fabrication techniques in collaboration with L&T.

publications.title: Finite Element Analysis of Stress Distributions in Mining Drills

achievements: Patent holder for 'Adaptive Shock-Absorbing Mechanics for Heavy Utility Vehicles' (2024)

name: Dr. Deepak Vyas
bio: Dr. Deepak Vyas focuses on applied engineering physics and semiconductor thin-films. He leads the materials research laboratory at SPSU, investigating green energy storage devices.

publications.title: Synthesis of Transition Metal Oxide Nanoparticles for Supercapacitors

achievements: Principal Investigator, DST-SERB Core Research Grant (2023-2026)
Fellow of the Physics Academy of India

name: Dr. Disha Mathur
bio: Dr. Disha Mathur possesses 15+ years of academic and administrative experience. Her research centers around organizational behavior, women empowerment, and human resource policies.

publications.title: Impact of Hybrid Work Models on Employee Engagement in Rajasthan

name: Dr. Manish Dadhich
bio: Dr. Manish Dadhich is a financial analyst and corporate consultant specializing in fintech adoption, stock market dynamics, and digital payment systems.

publications.title: Predictive Models for Cryptocurrency Markets Using Neural Networks

achievements: Consultant for leading investment firms on block-trading policies (2023)

name: Dr. Emmanuel Daanoba Sunkari
bio: Dr. Emmanuel Daanoba Sunkari is an expert in environmental geology, geochemical mapping, and sustainable mining practices. He publishes research in water pollution and mineral resources management.

publications.title: Fluoride Hydrogeochemistry in Arid Groundwater Reservoirs

name: Dr. Avinash Ojha
bio: Dr. Avinash Ojha teaches geotechnical engineering and structural safety. His research evaluates sustainable concrete composites and earthquake resistant designs.

publications.title: Performance of Cementitious Composites Embedded with Recycled Glass

achievements: Consulting Geologist for JK Cement Quarry Expansion

name: Dr. Ashutosh Gupta
bio: Dr. Ashutosh Gupta researches computer networks, cybersecurity, and cryptography. He works closely with Xebia to teach Advanced DevSecOps and cloud architectures to undergraduate cohorts.

publications.title: Preventing DDoS Vulnerabilities in Cloud Native Architectures

name: Dr. Arun Vaishnav
bio: Dr. Arun Vaishnav has over 10 years of experience in computer science education, focusing on full stack technologies, dynamic routing protocols, and database performance tuning.

publications.title: Reducing Response Latencies in Distributed SQL Frameworks

achievements: Lead Web Development Architect for the University Portal Revamp Project

name: Dr. Prithvi Singh
bio: Dr. Prithvi Singh specializes in molecular physics and computational astrophysics. He instructs courses in electrodynamics and mathematical methods in physics.

publications.title: Electronic Transitions and Spectra of Triatomic Radicals

achievements: Invited Speaker at the National Physics Congress (2024)

name: Dr. Shweta Lalwani
bio: Dr. Shweta Lalwani oversees academic development for liberal studies, communication design, and gaming. Her research centers around design thinking, UI/UX aesthetics, and cognitive mapping.

publications.title: UX Aesthetics and Customer Trust in Educational Platforms

achievements: Curator for the SPSU Annual Arts Exhibition (2025)
Advisory panelist for digital product aesthetics
